hypotheses.reasoning: ingest-api heap climbs steadily from about 32-36% at 00:15-00:20 to 78% after full GC at 00:21:03 (#99), 84% at 00:23 (#135), and 90% with 50% GC overhead at 00:26 (#179). It then throws OutOfMemoryError at eventCache.put (#182, #214, #243) and is OOMKilled against its 2Gi limit (#183, #215, #244). Each kill leaves ingest-api unavailable, and the gateway returns 502 with 'no healthy upstream' (#185, #203). The eventCache has no eviction, so memory only grows until the pod is killed. enrichment-svc, geo-cache and events-db are healthy, so the fault is inside ingest-api.

verdict.recommendedAction: Immediately stabilize ingest-api (scale out or drain the crashing pods) to stop the 502 bursts. Root fix: find why eventCache grows without bound in ingest-api, then add a size bound and TTL/eviction and confirm entries are released after processing. Raise the pod memory limit only as a temporary measure. Investigate client k-4124's burst traffic (#186). Add heap alerting below the 90% threshold.
